response.overview: We know childhood has ended, when we have to make our own decisions, and take our lives into our hands. And when we're overwhelmed by adulthood, drowning in responsibilities, not knowing where to run, we can always go back and fall into the arms of childhood, and rest our heads for a little. Adult life requires making big decisions and taking risks, and sometimes, all it takes to do that is getting rid of our fears, and be a child again.
response.title: The Swings
